description: Tracking SDG7 - The Energy Progress Report Application is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Tracking SDG7: The Energy Progress Report provides the international community with a global dashboard to register progress on the targets of Sustainable Development Goal 7 (SDG7): ensuring universal energy access, doubling progress on energy efficiency, substantially increasing the share of renewable energy, and enhance international cooperation to facilitate access to clean and renewable energy by ... Coverage: 187 countries in East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in HTML. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
